verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a consumer AI search app and API like Perplexity, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers telemetry, usage-tracking controls, data-retention settings or any opt-out mechanism. The robots.txt and crawler controversies concern Perplexity's crawling of other sites, not tracking of its own users, so they are off-topic.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
